statement: The F11 seven-point map has a specified integral left inverse on abelianizations, also after full completion. The residual A5 centralizer therefore lies in the exact s^2=t index-two cover of the rank-six source. Quotient by the common involution gives an injective full-completion map from the rank-eleven source Y=P1 minus {0,infinity,+/-mu5} to the pure eight-puncture mapping-class completion. The residual centralizer is exactly the equalizer of this map and the specified based quotient involution R(v)=(v2/v3,v2,v2/v1,v2/v5,v2/v4). Its image in source homology lies in the anti-invariant rank-five module and satisfies exactly the two displayed restrictions of the twenty winding equations, with an explicit rank-three kernel. The F11 common-kernel element has first winding defect4, excluding every nonzero profinite power from this equalizer.
where_proved: Part F, statement F.12; work/part_a/f_common_reflection.tex; code/part_a/c5_common_reflection_f12.py and its exact output
depends_on: F11 actual rank-six centralizer, labels, full topology, source word and paths; F7.4-5 prime-order normalizer/centralizer comparison and full induced topology; F7.9 actual forgetting constraints; A12 point-pushing and discrete peripheral mapping-class identifications; the explicit finite quotient and divisor calculations proved here
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Part F, nonsolvable A5 centralizer comparison on the twelve-punctured sphere
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The source double cover, full normalizer quotient with its actual finite deck kernel, branch labels, based Mobius normalization, quotient permutation, and both directions of the equalizer identification are explicit.
notes: The six normalized difference characters pull back to constant multiples of t and t-zeta^k, giving an exact abelianization splitting, so the residual source lies in the closed commutator subgroup before passage to Y. The common involution quotient is Q_s(z)=((z-s)/(z+s))^2, with branch values0,infinity and pole-pair value1. Full descent is injective on the pure completed centralizer because the only deck kernel is the named involution, whose puncture permutation is nontrivial. The second involution beta=(13)(45) commutes tau=(15)(34), and they together with C5 generate A5. The exact quotient permutation is (0 2)(1 3)(4 5), and its actual Mobius representative gives the based R action. Both directions of the equalizer correspondence use these actual maps and the completed descent injection. All twenty winding identities on the anti-invariant source module reduce to a0-a1+a2=0 and -a1+a3+a4=0. The module basis is given, but its equality with the image of the residual group is not asserted. The lifted F11 word is m_-zeta minus m_+zeta in homology and has winding defect4, so the full procyclic exclusion follows from multiplication by4 on Zhat. Triviality of the complete equalizer and the residual A5 centralizer remains Open.
